async def act(page):
    # Get all 'Preview' links
    preview_links = page.get_by_role('link', name='Preview')
    jekyll_index = None
    # Iterate through the links to find the one with 'jekyll' in the URL
    for i in range(await preview_links.count()):
        link = preview_links.nth(i)
        href = await link.get_attribute('href')
        if href and 'jekyll' in href.lower():
            jekyll_index = i
            break
    if jekyll_index is None:
        raise ValueError('JEKYLL template not found in the list of Preview links.')
    # Click the corresponding 'Use template' radio button at the same index
    jekyll_radio = page.get_by_role('radio', name='Use template').nth(jekyll_index)
    await jekyll_radio.click()
    # Wait for the page to update after selection
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
